Right. so the mock is exactly what the name says. a mock. i wanted to mock out what the interface felt like before anything was made. that does not mean the code in place is what is being used. but the way its currently laid out is the style approach to take without a doubt no freestyling some new approach.  but yes, fresh. and no cross importing files. we can clone files that are reusable and repurpose where i say its fit but not cross dir exporting nonsense.  to your other question yes and no. all the zig code has to go into the framework code already thats not anything u can work around, as for react related code i would just do the same anyways, that makes it less of a one off . everything is effectively being replaced. there will be two routes. the game and the editor. there will be one way to author models. this is why i shared the modelviewer demo file its the zig native approach that smokes the current studio. but all the studio capabilities need to be remade as host functions. no react bullshit. react is for writing a ui not for writing interactable systems and that is a strict rule to be followed

the eventbus i want fresh. i want you to build it from the point of view that the editor is a multiplayer editor even if it never makes it that way. its a future vision of the whole app but its also a strong principle to follow. this means, quite literally everything has to go through it 

keybinding im not sure i would just do sensible defaults obviously  logging and telemetry yes but to my knowledge that only captures javascript problems and we are making zig tools so we have to go more robust. and we want to be damn sure that logging is made one time when its needed and never again. styling yes strictly the classifier system the jsx because you should not be doing some abstract and retarded react app to try and do what zig is going to be handling everything should read like a document effectively. i do not want to see any inline styles at all unless there is a damn good reason for it to exist. no one offs.  i dont really know for the contenthash store but im sure its 10 times faster in zig so yes
